findings.obligation: A failing image must not move latest
findings.observation: publish pushes latest (push: true, lines 116-119) and only then runs the oracle against the pushed image (line 127); a failure there leaves a bad latest already pullable. Verify gates the same sources earlier so risk is build-to-build difference only. Non-blocking.
findings.remediation: Push the sha tag first, check it, then retag latest; or accept and document.

findings.obligation: Runner starts on boot with no key plugged in
findings.observation: Long-syntax type: bind with source /dev/bus/usb fails at compose up when the host path is absent (long syntax does not create it). Counterexample: boot where no USB bus exists yet, the unit fails and the runner stays offline. Oracle only renders config. Non-blocking, unlikely on a desktop.
findings.remediation: Maintainer confirms /dev/bus/usb exists at boot at EXAMINE (P1).

findings.observation: config.sh receives the short-lived registration token on argv (--token $registration_token), visible in /proc to processes of the one-shot register container; oracle checks only the PAT. The cp of credentials at lines 93-95 uses the default umask, so they are world-readable inside the volume. Non-blocking.
findings.remediation: Accept and note, or umask 077 before the copies.
